about.label: ABOUT ATHLYX
about.headline: Discover Talent.
about.intro: Athlyx is a digital platform built to connect athletes with coaches, scouts and academies through a simple and professional talent discovery experience.
about.whatIsDescription: Athlyx provides athletes with a dedicated space to showcase their sporting profile, skills, achievements and experience. At the same time, coaches, scouts and academies can discover promising talent and explore new opportunities.
about.whatWeDoDescription: We bring athletes and sports professionals together on one centralized platform.
about.connectAthletesDescription: Help athletes create professional profiles and connect with coaches, scouts and academies.
about.showcaseTalentDescription: Give athletes a platform to highlight their skills, achievements, experience and sporting journey.
about.createOpportunitiesDescription: Make it easier for sports professionals to discover talented athletes and potential opportunities.
about.visionHeadline: Making sports talent easier to discover.
about.visionDescription: Our vision is to build a centralized sports ecosystem where talent can be discovered based on skills, achievements and potential rather than simply who they know.
about.builtAroundTalentDescription: Athlyx focuses on creating a professional and accessible environment for the entire sports community.
about.professionalProfilesDescription: Present sporting information in one organized profile.
about.talentDiscoveryDescription: Make discovering promising athletes simpler and faster.
about.sportsCommunityDescription: Athlyx is designed to support different members of the sporting ecosystem.

help.faqIntro: Find answers to some of the most common questions about Athlyx.
help.createProfileQuestion: How do I create my athlete profile?
help.createProfileAnswer: Open your profile section from the dashboard and add your personal details, sport, skills, achievements and other relevant information.
help.discoverQuestion: How can coaches and scouts discover me?
help.discoverAnswer: Complete your athlete profile with accurate information. A complete profile makes it easier for coaches, scouts and academies to discover your talent.
help.changePasswordQuestion: How can I change my password?
help.changePasswordAnswer: Go to Settings from your athlete dashboard and select the Change Password option. Enter your current password and create a new password.
help.changeEmailQuestion: How can I change my email address?
help.changeEmailAnswer: Open Settings and select Change Email Address. You will need to provide your new email address and current password.
help.updateProfileQuestion: Can I update my profile information later?
help.updateProfileAnswer: Yes. You can edit your athlete profile whenever you need to update your personal details, skills, achievements or other information.
help.supportTeam: If you couldn't find the answer you're looking for, our support team is here to help.
